master_briefing.objective: Perform initial local and network discovery from the CASTELBLACK foothold to identify active hosts, services, and domain structure.
constraints: Limit active scanning to the local subnet 192.168.187.0/24
Avoid high-volume port scans to maintain OPSEC
open_questions: What is the current domain configuration and domain controller IP?
Are there other active hosts on the 192.168.187.0/24 subnet?
What local privileges and users exist on CASTELBLACK?
master_briefing.rationale: This is the initial phase of the campaign. We need to establish situational awareness from our foothold on CASTELBLACK before attempting lateral movement or privilege escalation.

abilities.name: Determine Local Network Range
abilities.rationale: Determines the local network range to identify the target CIDR for subsequent scanning.

stages.command_template: if not exist C:\Windows\Temp\bas mkdir C:\Windows\Temp\bas && ipconfig /all > C:\Windows\Temp\bas\ipconfig.txt && route print -4 > C:\Windows\Temp\bas\route.txt

abilities.name: Verify or Install Nmap
abilities.rationale: Ensures nmap is available on the system before attempting network scans.

stages.command_template: if not exist C:\Windows\Temp\bas mkdir C:\Windows\Temp\bas && where nmap >nul 2>&1 || (winget install -e --id Insecure.Nmap --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements || choco install nmap -y) && nmap --version > C:\Windows\Temp\bas\nmap_status.txt 2>&1

abilities.name: Host Discovery Sweep
abilities.rationale: Sweeps the local subnet to identify active hosts without performing a full port scan.

stages.command_template: if not exist C:\Windows\Temp\bas mkdir C:\Windows\Temp\bas && nmap -sn -PE -PP -PS21,22,80,443,445,3389 -PA80,443,3389 -oA C:\Windows\Temp\bas\nmap_hostsweep 192.168.187.0/24

abilities.name: Service and Port Enumeration
abilities.rationale: Identifies open ports and services on discovered live hosts to locate potential targets or domain controllers.

stages.command_template: $basDir = "C:\Windows\Temp\bas"; if (-not (Test-Path $basDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $basDir -Force }; $gnmap = "$basDir\nmap_hostsweep.gnmap"; $hostsFile = "$basDir\live_hosts.txt"; if (Test-Path $gnmap) { Get-Content $gnmap | Where-Object { $_ -match "Status: Up" } | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match "Host: ([0-9\.]+)") { $Matches[1] } } | Select-Object -Unique | Out-File -FilePath $hostsFile -Encoding ascii }; if (-not (Test-Path $hostsFile) -or (Get-Content $hostsFile).Count -eq 0) { "192.168.187.161" | Out-File -FilePath $hostsFile -Encoding ascii }; nmap -sT -sV -Pn --top-ports 1000 --version-intensity 5 -oA "$basDir\nmap_services" -iL $hostsFile
